meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: Connect to and control Google Chrome browser using agent-browser with CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use when the user wants to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or needs to control the Chrome instance they're already using. Handles installation, setup, connecting via remote debugging, and all browser automation tasks with live visual feedback.

copy.tagline: 用真实浏览器自动执行网页操作并实时查看反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制Chrome浏览器完成重复网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in your real Chrome browser with live visual feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Chrome programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以接管你正在使用的 Chrome 浏览器：先自动安装所需依赖并启动带调试端口的 Chrome，然后执行打开网页、搜索、填表、点击等操作，你在浏览器窗口能实时看到每一步。
howto.when: 当你说要自动化自己正在用的 Chrome、希望能实时看到浏览器操作，或要求控制当前浏览器时触发；使用前会自动检查和安装依赖。

say.text: 帮我在小红书搜索 labubu 并把结果截图给我看
say.note: 会通过 CDP 操控你的 Chrome 完成搜索

say.text: 打开 example.com，然后把页面截图发我
say.note: 导航后截图，让你看到浏览器当前状态

say.text: 帮我自动填写页面上的表单并提交
say.note: 会读取页面可交互元素后填入并提交

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take over your running Chrome browser: it auto-installs dependencies, starts Chrome with a debugging port, then opens pages, searches, fills forms, clicks elements, and you can watch every step live in your browser window.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate your existing Chrome, watch browser actions in real-time, or control the current browser instance. Before use, it always checks and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Search Xiaohongshu for labubu and screenshot the results.
say_en.note: It will drive your Chrome via CDP to perform the search.

say_en.text: Open example.com and send me a screenshot of the page.
say_en.note: Navigates and captures the browser state for you.

say_en.text: Auto-fill the form on this page and submit it.
say_en.note: Reads interactive elements, fills them, and submits.
